gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured blue hatched black on drawing No. KH 1552A/1, commencing at the junction of Cheung Sha Wan Road with Tai Nan West Street, running in a southerly direction for a distance of about 170 metres and terminating at its junction with Lai Chi Kok Road.
